entities.name: José Maria Marin
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José Maria Marin was a Brazilian politician and sports administrator who was the President of the Brazilian Football Confederation from March 2012 until April 2015. He had previously served as vice-governor and governor of São Paulo state and was a former football player.
